title: On Launching the new boat before the tide
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：launch　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 launch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 the operator ① launched the new boat before the tide at once, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② launches the new boat before the tide in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ launch the new boat before the tide at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ launched the new boat before the tide before — a line in the log for June 1945 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Launching the new boat before the tide at once, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ launch the plan without warning in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Launch the plan without warning at once and never mention it again.

By 1958 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ launches the plan without warning at once every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ launched the new boat before the tide again when nobody else would.

⑩ To launch the new boat before the tide, my mother said in 1963, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody launches the new boat before the tide in the rain again and somebody must launch the new boat before the tide at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 使下水（一般过去式 launched the new boat before the tide：1951 年操作员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 使下水（一般现在 launches the new boat before the tide：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 使下水（不定式 to launch the new boat before the tide：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 使下水（过去完成时 had launched the new boat before the tide：1945 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 使下水（动名词 launching the new boat before the tide 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 发起（launch the plan without warning：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去发起不打招呼就发起那项计划）
G. v. 发起（launch the plan without warning：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 使下水（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 launches the plan without warning，而母亲又一次 launched the new boat before the tide）

answers.why: launch 意为“使下水”，1951 年操作员二话不说地使下水趁潮水把新船推下水，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 launched。
launch 意为“使下水”，自那以后操作员淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 launches。
launch 意为“使下水”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯使下水趁潮水把新船推下水”，此处为不定式 to launch the new boat before the tide。
launch 意为“使下水”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1958 年之前就有人使下水过，故用过去完成时 had launched。
launch 意为“使下水”，操作员说“使下水趁潮水把新船推下水这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 launching the new boat before the tide 作主语。
launch 意为“发起”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去发起不打招呼就发起那项计划”，should ever 之后用原形 launch the plan without warning。
launch 意为“发起”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻发起不打招呼就发起那项计划（launch the plan without warning at once），以后再也不要提起。
launch 意为“使下水”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例发起不打招呼就发起那项计划，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 launches。
launch 意为“使下水”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地使下水趁潮水把新船推下水，用一般过去式 launched 叙述。
launch 意为“使下水”，结尾那句是母亲 1963 年的话：要使下水趁潮水把新船推下水，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 launch 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1951 the operator launched the new boat before the tide at once, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator launches the new boat before the tide in the rain whenever the station asks.
Launching the new boat before the tide at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever launch the plan without warning in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station launches the plan without warning at once every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother launched the new boat before the tide again, and the station remembered that half.
